method: Elevations sampled straight out of the published GeoTIFFs over HTTP range requests (probes/probe_dem.py). Window half-widths 100 m, which is the spots.json coordinate error bar, and 25 m. All values are metres in each tile's own vertical datum, which is NAVD88 for every decoded dataset. These are NOT MLLW feet.

not_decoded.8684: LZW compression; not decoded by this recon
